description: Open a remote Windows desktop inside the Integrated Browser via a local Guacamole RDP gateway.
welcome.contents:
Open your Azure Windows desktop inside Token Effort via the local Guacamole gateway.
[Open Desktop](command:windowsVm.openDesktop)
[Start Gateway](command:windowsVm.startGateway)
[Stop Gateway](command:windowsVm.stopGateway)
[Show Gateway Logs](command:windowsVm.showLogs)
[Set VM Password](command:windowsVm.setPassword)
configuration.title: Windows VM
configuration.host: Hostname or IP address of the Windows VM (RDP target).
configuration.rdpPort: RDP port on the Windows VM.
configuration.domain: Optional Windows domain for the RDP session.
configuration.security: RDP security mode negotiated with the VM.
configuration.ignoreCert: Ignore RDP server certificate errors (typical for Azure VMs with self-signed certificates).
configuration.resizeMethod: How the remote desktop resolution follows the editor pane size. 'display-update' resizes live; 'reconnect' reconnects on resize.
configuration.colorDepth: Color depth of the RDP session in bits per pixel.
configuration.gatewayPort: Local port the Guacamole gateway listens on (bound to 127.0.0.1 only).
configuration.sessionHours: How long a minted desktop session URL stays valid, in hours.
configuration.imageTag: Docker image tag for the guacamole/guacamole and guacamole/guacd images.
configuration.openToSide: Open the desktop tab in a locked side editor group so it stays visible while you work.
configuration.sshEnabled: Tunnel RDP over SSH instead of connecting directly (requires SSH access to the VM).
configuration.sshUser: SSH username on the Windows VM.
configuration.sshPort: SSH port on the Windows VM.
